title: Chapter 1079
paragraphs: Chapter 1079
Episode 254. The Egos of the Sun God (3)
Another day passed.
Following Beltian, the Vamel Alliance was able to successfully restrain Nepdol as well. And Nepdol, surprisingly, showed signs of adapting to the Vamel Alliance very quickly.
[Kkyu... Bligiet was right. Seeing the state of this world, if I don't help you, something terrible will happen.]
It was thanks to the 'memory of the beginning.' The moment Nepdol weakened, Bligiet shared the memory of the beginning with her without a moment's rest, and Ameris and Lucy also helped them.
Nepdol very quickly remembered the solitude of the time when she was whole. The truth of the multiple worlds also influenced her decision to lend her strength to the Vamel Alliance.
[A wise decision, Subordinate No. 2.]
[Stop calling me that, Bligiet. You were originally weaker than me in terms of authority.]
[But what is the reality now? I am the ego of the Sun God who was the first to realize the memory of the beginning. Show some respect.]
[You only say the most annoying things. We're both going to be lending our strength to the Battle God Temple's power source anyway.]
The coalition chose Beltian as the power source for the Battle God Temple's main hall.
However, Beltian, unlike Bligiet and Nepdol, was still showing hostility towards the coalition even in his restrained state.
[If that friend Beltian had come to his senses like us, he wouldn't have been tied to the power source. That part is unfortunate.]

Bligiet and Nepdol's role was to prevent Beltian's 'rampage.' Beltian was continuously emitting an enormous amount of solar energy even while restrained, and if it became severe enough to damage the power source, the two egos would stop it.
“The development of the power source will be completed in the near future. If we're fast, it could be finished within a few days.”

The egos of the Sun God nodded at Jin's words. From the moment they captured Beltian, the most important part of the power source was as good as complete, so all that was left was the development of devices to improve its stability. Even that was only at the level of modifying parts used in the Golden Fleet, so it was bound to be fast.
Everything related to the development of the Battle God Temple as a flying fortress was proceeding smoothly.

For the past two days since the battle with Nepdol, there had been no massacres of civilians by the Zipple. There had also been no particular reports on the issues they had learned about through the dream ability.
Instead, the coalition was sensing another danger.
[Even if we're fast, it won't be finished within today, right? Jin.]
“Yes, Lord Nepdol.”
[Kkyuu, this is a problem. I'm sure of it, Kragos is waking up...]
The ego of destruction, Kragos.
The egos of the Sun God could feel that he had awoken. It was just that some great power was interfering with their detection ability, so they couldn't pinpoint his location.
As far as the egos of the Sun God knew, there was only one being who could wield such power, Malugia.
[Malugia is definitely stopping us from finding Kragos. And she must have shared some of her power with Kragos as well.]
Nepdol said, trembling as if in fear.

[As Subordinate No. 2 said, we must now move with the assumption that Malugia has begun to act in earnest. That means Kelliark Zipple is as good as a puppet. Before Malugia's power, that mortal will be nothing more than a mere beast.]
“Tsk, that Kelliark bastard was already on a leash held by Lokia, and now he's been caught by someone even worse. Hasn't Lokia's threat to Kelliark all come to nothing now?”
Murakan said with a shrug, but Jin shook his head.

“We can't know that yet. According to the dream ability, when she first tried to separate Malugia from the Origin Stone in front of Kelliark, Malugia showed no particular reaction. That means Malugia's current active state may not be constant.”

[Kkyu, that's right. Malugia is likely revealing her power and acting intermittently. But with just that, she has already awoken Kragos and is even hiding him from us, ugh... that girl, what on earth is she thinking. It would be easier if she were simple-minded like Beltian.]
Beltian had been easily defeated after crying out for nothing but destruction from the moment he awoke, but Malugia was moving with extreme meticulousness in many ways.
From the time she was active as Elona Zipple, in whom she had dwelled for a thousand years, until now, she had never once revealed her form to her enemies.

“Lady Elona... no, Malugia, it is highly likely that she was aware of the truth of the multiple worlds long before the egos of the Sun God came to the surface like this. Because if her goal was just the destruction of this world, she had countless opportunities over the past thousand years.”
If her goal was to ruin the 677th dimension, this current world, Malugia could have realized that at any time.

In the history of the mortal world, before the Vamel Alliance had formed a force that was close to the strongest in history, the period where there wasn't even a single Genesis Knight was much longer.
However, Malugia never once did so. In addition to that, the words that Hailyn Runcandel left for Lucy were also meaningful.
-To destroy all worlds, we need Lokia Ganesto. Mom and Marcos, stay here.

'Malugia, who dwells in Lady Elona, and Araxion, who dwells in Lady Hailyn, were already aware of the dimensional branching from the moment the thousand-year history manipulation began, and are therefore waiting for the right time for the ruin of all dimensions... It all fits perfectly. Furthermore, since Lord Bligiet said that Malugia is currently letting herself be captured by the Zipple...'

Just as Malugia had let herself be captured by the Zipple for some reason, Araxion might also be in a similar situation. If so, not only Kelliark but also Lokia could be called the puppets of the egos of Ruin.
[The question is why Malugia chose the Zipple, of all things, and why Araxion chose the Ganesto.]
[Kkyu, I agree with you on that, Bligiet. It would have been better in many ways to choose Vahn, who inherited most of our power without having any authority.]

“The Zipples are the ones who created the dimensional branching through history manipulation, and the Ganestos are the mortals who can use the power of Chaos most freely. It's likely because those two factors are closely related to the ruin of all dimensions.”
[Ah, that could be it. History manipulation and Chaos... You and your family have been resisting them most strongly for a thousand years.]
[Then that must be the reason Solderet chose you Runcandels. To oppose Malugia and Araxion. Once your father finds Solderet's arrangement in the Black Sea, all the clues will be unraveled.]

“Above all, the current Zipple is in a position that is close to a bridgehead from the perspective of the Demon Army. If I were Malugia, I think I would use the Zipple to lure the Demon Army to this dimension and eliminate them. Or by luring the DemonArmy to this dimension, create a situation where she can directly attack their home base.”
[That too has a point.]
“If this hypothesis is true, the power of Chaos will likely be used in relation to inter-dimensional interference. It would be good to get confirmation on this part from the witch through Orgal...”
[Ta-da, Orgal appears. I heard everything, I heard it all. For that part, I'll tell Masalrun, Sribi, and Karmasu, the three demons, to go meet Helluram. Of course, she might not meet them?]
Even seeing Orgal suddenly pop out, Jin no longer shook his head or said anything unpleasant.
It was true that he and his third-rate terrorist group, Kinzelo, had committed heinous acts in the past, but now, at least for the present, they could be called a reliable ally.

'Both Orgal and I. In the end, we will likely devote our entire lives to atonement someday. He, for the evils he committed in this world before he knew the truth, and I, for the sin of ruining the lives of many people as a regressor.'
As soon as Orgal arrived, he touched Nepdol's smooth head and let out a silly laugh.
[Aww, so cute. To think that a gentle creature like this became a material for a Origin Stone in another dimension.]
[Hands off!]
“What brings you here this time, Orgal.”

[We have to go catch Kragos now, don't we? I came to lend a hand. That damn ego of destruction is probably planning to smash this entire world to pieces from somewhere safe under Malugia's protection. But Jin, you have to be careful this time.]
“Careful?”

[It's a given that he has received Malugia's power, isn't it? If we don't fight properly... no, even if we do fight properly, our side will inevitably receive no small amount of damage. Depending on the case, quite a few of our companions will die.]
Although Orgal was speaking in a cheerful voice, within it was buried the emptiness of one who had lost countless companions while crossing numerous dimensions over a long time.

[The feeling of a companion, a comrade in arms, dying. Even a guy with as much experience as me can't get used to it. And it's not like Kragos is the only enemy... In the worst case, we might have to face the Tower of Stories or even Malugia and Araxion.]
Jin slowly nodded his head.
“Kragos, empowered by Malugia. Have you ever fought in a similar situation in another dimension?”

[I have. It's not exactly the same, but... be prepared. No matter who dies, the one thing that must not happen is you falling to demonic transformation. The most important thing right now is turning the Battle God Temple's main hall into a flying fortress.]
“We are putting all our efforts into it, excluding the personnel for search and defense. Ah, that reminds me. Send Bubar Gaston to the construction yard.”
[Ah! Bubar! Yes, everyone hates that guy, but you can't deny his ability. He's also a surprisingly loyal bastard, that one. I'll send the Cold team along with Bubar. I hadn't thought of that.]
Soon, Orgal opened the steel gate again and looked back at Jin.
[I don't know about the others, but you absolutely must not die, Jin. Well then, I'll send those two over and be right back, so let's start the search for Kragos.]
“Understood. You don't die either.”
The moment Orgal left and the Vamel Alliance began to seriously prepare for the search.
Kragos was just revealing his form in an important area of the Vamel Alliance.
The Imperial Capital, the land of Dante.
